FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'I am well, thank you.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça va bien, merci.
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Je m'appelle Njeri.
   D. Et toi ?

2. What does 'la famille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the father
   B. the family
   C. the girl
   D. the grandfather

3. How do you say 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Demain, c'est jeudi.
   B. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   C. Le jeudi, je chante.
   D. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

4. How do you say 'I am ten years old.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai dix ans.
   B. Voici un cadeau pour toi.
   C. C'est le premier janvier.
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

5. Which month is 'novembre'? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. October
   C. November
   D. December

6. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: What does Amina give Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. a balloon
   B. a song
   C. a cake
   D. a present

7. What does 'les légumes' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cheese
   B. the banana
   C. vegetables
   D. chicken

8. How do you say 'I have ten fingers.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il a les cheveux courts.
   B. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   C. J'ai dix doigts.
   D. Il est grand.

9. How do you say 'I stay in the house.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je reste dans la maison.
   B. Il fait froid.
   C. Aujourd'hui, il pleut.
   D. Il pleut.

10. What does 'fort' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold.
   B. a flood
   C. strong
   D. It is hot.

11. What does 'le tapis' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the garden
   B. the rug
   C. the shop
   D. the key

12. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: Which way should she turn? (1 mark)
   A. right
   B. back
   C. left
   D. up

13. What does 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hi, Kamau!
   B. Pleased to meet you!
   C. What is your name?
   D. My name is Njeri.

14. What does 'Voici ma grand-mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandfather.
   B. My sister is called Njeri.
   C. Here is my grandmother.
   D. My mother is called Grace.

15. Which little word goes with 'fille' (the girl)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

16. What does 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. Here is my grandmother.
   C. This is my brother.
   D. My brother is called Kamau.

17. What does 'Une semaine, sept jours.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I play.
   B. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   C. What day is it today?
   D. A week, seven days.

18. What does 'J'ai dix ans.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My birthday is on 12 May.
   B. Happy birthday!
   C. I am ten years old.
   D. I sing and I dance.

19. Which little word goes with 'jus' (the juice)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

20. Which little word goes with 'dent' (the tooth)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

21. What does 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is next to the window.
   B. The cat is behind the door.
   C. It is under the chair.
   D. Where is the key?

22. How do you say 'And you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Et toi ?
   C. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   D. Comment tu t'appelles ?

23. How do you say 'the child' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. la mère
   C. la famille
   D. l'enfant

24. How do you say the month 'February' in French? (1 mark)
   A. novembre
   B. mars
   C. septembre
   D. février

25. How do you write the number 17 in French? (1 mark)
   A. treize
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. huit
   D. dix-sept

26. How do you say 'milk' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jus
   B. le lait
   C. les bonbons
   D. le gâteau

27. How do you say 'the finger' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. le cou
   C. le doigt
   D. l'épaule

28. How do you say 'It is freezing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il gèle.
   C. Il y a des nuages.
   D. Il y a du vent.

29. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'pleasant'? (1 mark)
   A. agréable
   B. agrèable
   C. agreable
   D. agréble

30. Fill in: Mets le tapis ______ le canapé. (in front of) (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. sous
   C. sur
   D. devant

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'C'est un lit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'He has short hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: 'Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

34. Write the French words for: the baby, the child, the mother (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'The book is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'Voici mon grand-père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'She has long hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Read the family tree: le père Otieno, la mère Njeri, la fille Amina, le garçon Kamau. Write two sentences in French about it. (4 marks) (4 marks)

39. Translate into English: 'Tournez à gauche.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into French: 'Today it is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'Salut, Kamau !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'It is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 30 June.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Allez tout droit.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'Hi, Kamau!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'Here is my house.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Write three sentences in French about what you eat in a day. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'It is a banana.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Qui est-ce ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A

1. A — Ça va bien, merci.
   I am well, thank you. in French is Ça va bien, merci.

2. B — the family
   la famille means the family.

3. A — Demain, c'est jeudi.
   Tomorrow it is Thursday. in French is Demain, c'est jeudi.

4. A — J'ai dix ans.
   I am ten years old. in French is J'ai dix ans.

5. C — November
   novembre means November.

6. D — a present
   Un cadeau is a present.

7. C — vegetables
   les légumes means vegetables.

8. C — J'ai dix doigts.
   I have ten fingers. in French is J'ai dix doigts.

9. A — Je reste dans la maison.
   I stay in the house. in French is Je reste dans la maison.

10. C — strong

11. B — the rug

12. C — left

14. C — Here is my grandmother.

   fille is feminine, so we say la fille.

16. D — My brother is called Kamau.

17. D — A week, seven days.

18. C — I am ten years old.

19. A — le
   jus is masculine, so we say le jus.

20. D — la

21. B — The cat is behind the door.

22. B — Et toi ?

23. D — l'enfant
